description:
Dive into a sea of smiles! This first coloring book has 30 big, simple pictures of friendly ocean animals, from a happy whale and a waving octopus to a sea turtle, a crab, a jellyfish and a dolphin leaping over a wave. Every picture has extra-thick lines and large open spaces, made for toddlers and little hands that are just starting to color.

What's inside
• 30 one-sided coloring pages, with a blank page behind each picture
• One big, simple subject on every page, with very few small details
• Extra-thick lines and large spaces for crayons and chunky markers
• A "This book belongs to" page and a color test page
• Large 8.5 x 11 inch pages

A fun quiet-time activity for toddlers and young children, and an easy gift for little ones who love the sea.

The inside pages are printed in black and white, ready for you to color. The colors on the cover are just an example.

The illustrations in this book were generated with AI image tools and were selected and arranged by the publisher, Little Fox Paper Co.
